verdict.rationale: Vast.ai docs claim tiered security verification for 'Secure Cloud' offers (TIER 2/3 datacenter rating or ISO 27001, blue-label 'recommended for production'), giving platform engineers some assurance signal, but there is no mention of SOC 2 or formal data-handling/compliance certification for the platform itself. A community report documents a concrete case of a host misrepresenting its location (Chinese host masquerading as US-based) on the marketplace, directly undercutting trust in the verification claims. missing for 10: SOC 2 or equivalent compliance attestation, documented data-handling/data-residency policies, and resolution of the host-verification failure reported by users.
